response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: AVG and SUM ignore NULLs naturally; if all rebtotal values in a group are NULL, total_rebate is NULL and sorts last (SQLite DESC puts NULLs last, NULLS LAST made explicit).
Ties in total rebate are broken arbitrarily since no tiebreaker was specified.
